cells.gaps: No figures of South Sudan's own traffic under the One Network Area have been found; the 900-fold rise is for the partner states together, and its communique of 9 November 2023 is now just over three years old.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13: the 2023 figures of use (SSD-008) are now just past three years, but in November 2026 an EAC official said the One Network Area South Sudan put into effect (SSD-007) had cut cross-border costs, so the country is still shown there and the stage holds at 5.
